content: स्नु €2 <ab>P.</ab> (स्नौति, स्नुत) .²1 To drip, trickle, fall in drops, distil, drop, ooze or run out, leak out, .²2 To flow, stream.
स्नु {%m., n.%} .²1 Table-land. .²2 Top, surface (in general). (This word has no forms for the first five inflections and is optionally substituted for सानु after <ab>acc.</ab> dual).
